name: GS.meetMan_worse_right
lines: n : ℕ
w m : Preferences n
μ ν : Matching (Fin n) (Fin n)
hμ : Matching.IsStable (MatchingMarket.ofEquivData w m) μ
hν : Matching.IsStable (MatchingMarket.ofEquivData w m) ν
i j : Fin n
hij : meetMan μ ν hμ hν i = j
hνij : wPartner ν hν j = i
⊢ List.idxOf (wPartner μ hμ j) (m.prefs j) ≤ List.idxOf i (m.prefs j)
hνm : mPartner ν hν i = j
case pos
heq : mPartner μ hμ i = j
case neg
heq : ¬mPartner μ hμ i = j
this : wPartner μ hμ j = i
hbranch : meetMan μ ν hμ hν i = mPartner ν hν i
⊢ meetMan μ ν hμ hν i = mPartner ν hν i
hlt0 : List.idxOf (mPartner ν hν i) (w.prefs i) < List.idxOf (mPartner μ hμ i) (w.prefs i)
⊢ List.idxOf (mPartner ν hν i) (w.prefs i) < List.idxOf (mPartner μ hμ i) (w.prefs i)
hge : ¬List.idxOf (mPartner ν hν i) (w.prefs i) < List.idxOf (mPartner μ hμ i) (w.prefs i)
⊢ False
hge : List.idxOf (mPartner μ hμ i) (w.prefs i) ≤ List.idxOf (mPartner ν hν i) (w.prefs i)
hbranch :
(if List.idxOf (mPartner μ hμ i) (w.prefs i) ≤ List.idxOf (mPartner ν hν i) (w.prefs i) then mPartner μ hμ i
else mPartner ν hν i) =
mPartner ν hν i
hbranch : mPartner μ hμ i = mPartner ν hν i
hlt0 : List.idxOf j (w.prefs i) < List.idxOf (mPartner μ hμ i) (w.prefs i)
hlt0 hlt : List.idxOf j (w.prefs i) < List.idxOf (mPartner μ hμ i) (w.prefs i)
this : List.idxOf (wPartner μ hμ j) (m.prefs j) < List.idxOf i (m.prefs j)

steps.tactic: have hνm : mPartner ν hν i = j := (wPartner_eq_iff ν hν).mp hνij
by_cases heq : mPartner μ hμ i = j
have : wPartner μ hμ j = i := (wPartner_eq_iff μ hμ).mpr heq
have hbranch : meetMan μ ν hμ hν i = mPartner ν hν i := by rw [hij, hνm]

have hlt0 : (w.prefs i).idxOf (mPartner ν hν i) < (w.prefs i).idxOf (mPartner μ hμ i) :=
  by
  by_contra hge
  push_neg at hge
  unfold meetMan at hbranch
  rw [if_pos hge] at hbranch
  exact heq (hbranch.trans hνm)
have hlt : (w.prefs i).idxOf j < (w.prefs i).idxOf (mPartner μ hμ i) := hlt0

have :=
  opposed_preferences_women μ hμ (mi := j) (mi' := mPartner μ hμ i) (j' := wPartner μ hμ j) (matchM_mPartner μ hμ i) hlt
    (matchW_wPartner μ hμ j)
